sources.title: Jiujiang University Danfengyuan data-centre room: September 30 maintenance notice
sources.summary: The existing Danfengyuan campus data-centre room supports academic affairs, student affairs, registration, finance contract management, office administration and other university systems. On September 30 the Information Technology Centre scheduled replacement and maintenance of its aging UPS supply for October 2–3, warning that services would temporarily become unavailable and asking departments to shut down servers, storage and network equipment. This establishes existing operation as of the notice; it does not confirm that the later cutover finished.
sources.original_title: 关于丹枫园校区数据中心机房UPS系统割接维护的通知
sources.author: 信息技术中心 (Information Technology Centre)
sources.date_semantics: Visible publication 2026年09月30日 08:59 and author signature 2026年9月30日. September 30 is the supported observation of existing room operations, not an opening date. October 2 08:00 to October 3 08:00 is a planned maintenance interval, not achieved work or a verified service-restoration date.
sources.lifecycle_basis: The notice identifies aging installed UPS equipment, named live university services that will temporarily become unavailable, and existing servers/storage/network equipment to shut down before maintenance. These concrete present-tense dependencies support existing operations; future cutover language is not treated as completion.
sources.scope_limit: Campus-card electricity purchases for Ziweiyuan buildings 4–6 are among affected services; this does not move the room to Ziweiyuan or establish a second physical data centre.

sources.title: Danfengyuan data-centre room modular UPS procurement
sources.summary: The university sought one batch of modular UPS equipment for the Danfengyuan campus data-centre room, with a CNY 320,000 budget and CNY 304,000 ceiling. Delivery, installation, wiring, testing and cutover within 30 days of contract signing were requirements. The tender does not confirm an award, installation or completion, and its budget is for the UPS package rather than the entire data centre.
sources.original_title: 九江学院信息技术中心丹枫园校区数据中心机房模块化UPS采购项目第二次
sources.date_semantics: Visible original publication is July 20, 2026 at 17:35. The page describes August file availability and bidding; these later dates do not replace its displayed publication date. Historical equipment context only.

sources.title: Danfengyuan campus identity: Jingzhi Building and 551 Qianjin East Road
sources.summary: The university identifies Jingzhi Building (竞知楼) as being on its Danfengyuan campus and directs visitors through the south gate at 551 Qianjin East Road. The named building is inside the selected community-mapped Jiujiang University campus. It is a campus-identity reference, not the data-centre room location.
sources.original_title: 关于九江学院2026年退役大学生士兵专升本免试考查的通知
sources.date_semantics: Historical address and named-campus identity only; the examination date is not a data-centre event.

sources.title: Danfengyuan campus address in university electrical-works tender
sources.summary: A separate university tender explicitly locates its works inside Danfengyuan campus at 551 Qianjin East Road, Lianxi District, Jiujiang. This corroborates the campus address. Its teaching-building electrical works, contract value and project status are separate from the data-centre room.
sources.original_title: 九江学院智能智造实训实验中心配套及丹枫园校区教学楼等电力增容工程（第二次）施工招标公告
sources.date_semantics: Historical campus-address context only. No construction milestone, consent or capacity from this separate tender is assigned to the data centre.

sources.title: Jiujiang University campus: OpenStreetMap way 264303327
sources.summary: A representative point inside the mapped Jiujiang University campus locates the Danfengyuan parent campus. University address and landmark evidence distinguish this campus from neighbouring Ziweiyuan. The marker does not identify the data-centre building or room.
sources.date_semantics: Map edit timestamp is location context, not a data-centre operating observation.

sources.title: Native map context: Jingzhi Building within Jiujiang University and separate Ziweiyuan campus
sources.summary: The native map places Jingzhi Building (竞知楼, way 690859928) within the selected Jiujiang University campus and labels the adjacent southeastern property separately as Ziweiyuan campus (way 666099948). This supports the named-campus identity bridge; neither building is selected as the data-centre room.
sources.date_semantics: Community-mapped spatial identity context only; no data-centre lifecycle observation.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap changeset 175133918: campus map provenance
sources.summary: The campus contributor recorded Bing aerial imagery as a mapping source. The Atlas uses the native community vector feature and claims no independent imagery verification or measured positional accuracy.
sources.date_semantics: Map-edit provenance only. The changeset bounding box is not the campus geometry.
